summary: Defines two Huawei-specific IPCP options for PPP that convey a set of ports. They can be used with port range-based or NAT-based approaches for port delegation and forwarding. It is an informational document describing a vendor's options.

eli5.summary: When several homes share one address, each can be given a range of door numbers. This describes two settings from one company for telling a device which door numbers it may use.
